title: Western blotting of Syp-VAMP2 complex
author: Caroline Brown
materials: Acquire the following antibodies for the Western blotting protocol:
Primary Antibody: rabbit Na/K ATPase (Abcam Cat# ab167390, 1:5000)
Primary Antibody: Synaptophysin Rabbit mAb (ABClonal Cat#A19122, 1:5000)
Primary Antibody: VAMP2 Rabbit mAb (ABClonal Cat#A4235, 1:5000)

steps.title: Run the Gel
steps.instruction: Run the gel until the loading dye front runs off the ends of the gel.

steps.title: Prepare and Load Protein Samples
steps.instruction: Measure protein concentration using a Bradford Kit, dilute samples into 4x Laemmli buffer to achieve a final concentration of 1x, and load onto a 4-20% Mini-PROTEAN TGX precast gel.

steps.title: Transfer Protein to Membrane
steps.instruction: Transfer the gel onto a PVDF membrane using a TurboBlot system.

steps.title: Block and Wash Membrane
steps.instruction: Block the membrane in 5% milk for 1 hour and wash with TBST.

steps.title: Primary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the membrane with the primary antibody at the appropriate concentration overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Secondary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the membrane with HRP Goat Anti-Rabbit IgG (H+L) (ABClonal Cat#AS014) at a 1:10000 dilution for 1 hour and wash with TBST.

steps.title: Detect Chemiluminescence
steps.instruction: Add HRP and detect chemiluminescence using an ImageQuant system.
